specs.name: findExponents_length
specs.stmt: ∀ (n : Nat) (primes : List Nat) (h_precond : findExponents_precond n primes), (findExponents n primes h_precond).length = primes.length

specs.name: findExponents_primes_covered
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (primes : List Nat) (h_precond : findExponents_precond n primes),
    primes.all (fun p => (findExponents n primes h_precond).any (fun pair => pair.1 = p))

specs.name: findExponents_keys_in_primes
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (primes : List Nat) (h_precond : findExponents_precond n primes),
    (findExponents n primes h_precond).all (fun (p, _) => p ∈ primes)

specs.name: findExponents_product_eq
specs.stmt: theorem findExponents_product_eq : ∀ (n : Nat) (primes : List Nat) (h_precond : findExponents_precond n primes), n = (findExponents n primes h_precond).foldl (fun acc (p, e) => acc * p ^ e) 1

specs.name: findExponents_keys_perm
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (primes : List Nat) (h_precond : findExponents_precond n primes),
    List.Perm ((findExponents n primes h_precond).map Prod.first) primes

specs.name: findExponents_keys_nodup
specs.stmt: ∀ (n : Nat) (primes : List Nat) (h_precond : findExponents_precond n primes), List.Nodup ((findExponents n primes h_precond).map Prod.fst)

specs.name: findExponents_nonempty
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (primes : List Nat) (h_precond : findExponents_precond n primes),
    (findExponents n primes h_precond).length > 0

specs.name: findExponents_exponents_nonneg
specs.stmt: theorem findExponents_exponents_nonneg : ∀ (n : Nat) (primes : List Nat) (h_precond : findExponents_precond n primes), (findExponents n primes h_precond).all (fun pair => pair.2 ≥ 0)

specs.name: findExponents_fst_eq_primes
specs.stmt: ∀ (n : Nat) (primes : List Nat) (h_precond : findExponents_precond n primes), (findExponents n primes h_precond).map Prod.fst = primes

specs.name: findExponents_factorization
specs.stmt: theorem findExponents_factorization : ∀ (n : Nat) (primes : List Nat) (h_precond : findExponents_precond n primes), let result

specs.name: findExponents_one_zero_exponents
specs.stmt:
∀ (primes : List Nat) (h_precond : findExponents_precond 1 primes),
    (findExponents 1 primes h_precond).all (fun (_, e) => e = 0)

specs.name: findExponents_single_prime
specs.stmt: theorem findExponents_single_prime : ∀ (n : Nat) (p : Nat) (h_precond : findExponents_precond n [p]), (findExponents n [p] h_precond).length = 1

specs.name: findExponents_keys_prime
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (primes : List Nat) (h_precond : findExponents_precond n primes),
    (findExponents n primes h_precond).all (fun (p, _) => Nat.Prime p)

specs.name: findExponents_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (primes : List Nat) (h_precond : findExponents_precond n primes),
    findExponents_postcond n primes (findExponents n primes h_precond) h_precond
